notes.title: Season 8 started
notes.content:
Dear player,
Season 8 started and all countries restarted.
The game is available now in Android/PC/Mac/IOS in all stores and platforms.

* Better events system added.
* It will be much more difficult to find rare resources 
* Markets, weapons & resources will be full again but there will be tax for buying/selling from the market.
* We limited the technologies Agriculture and Urbanization to 99 levels max. (On the server side, you might still see 999 levels but the system will allow only 99 levels and in case you buy more you will get your money back in the game automatically)
* Extra time protection for new players.* Ballistic missile system improved.
Good luck commanders…
